description: Stable key RR### built from the Census serial (the Census 'District_code' is a 1..640 serial, not the official code).
State/UT as spelled in the Census file.
District as spelled in the Census file.
Upper-cased, whitespace-cleaned, canonical state label (Orissa->ODISHA etc.).
State as of today for state-level joins (the 10 old Telangana districts moved out of ANDHRA PRADESH).
centroid_file, or polygon_centroid where the centroid file has no usable row.
Area of the dissolved 2011-district polygon on an India equal-area projection.
population_anchor (exact 2011 population match) or parent_map (post-2011 children folded into the 2011 parent).
Number of shapefile polygons dissolved into this district.
Crude literacy = Literate / total population (all ages).
Official effective literacy (population aged 7+). r=0.99 with the crude rate; kept because it is the standard, interpretable definition. Missing for Bangalore Rural.
Female workers / female population. High values in poor agrarian districts reflect farm labour, not opportunity.
Cultivators + agricultural labourers as % of workers. RURALITY PROXY (the supplied Census file has no urban/rural split).

Active (timetabled) stations inside the district polygon. 0 is a confirmed zero (national timetable).
Sum over the district's stations of distinct trains stopping (timetable is undated; treat as a relative service level).
Distinct trains that stop at >=1 station in the district.
Great-circle distance from district centroid to the nearest active station (can exceed 1,000 km for islands).
Distinct markets reporting on 19-May-2025. NaN = district not in the snapshot (NOT zero).
Distinct commodities reported in the district. NaN as above.
Active job cards / job cards issued.
Average days of employment per household (financial year of the file, undated).
Households completing 100 days / households that worked.
How the NREGA row was matched to the 2011 district (exact / alias / fuzzy). Ratios only, because new districts split old ones.
Doctors in position / required at PHCs, capped at 100. Same value for every district of the state.
Vacant / sanctioned posts (NaN where the state did not report).
PHC doctors in position per 100,000 state population.
Mean of available years of the primary dropout ratio ('NR' cells ignored).
Reference period of the Census block.
Reference period of the railway block.
Reference date of the mandi snapshot (blank where not observed).

Mean of winsorised-scaled: Literacy_Rate_Effective, Secondary_Edu_pct, log Graduate_pct.
Mean of: inverted log Nearest_Railway_km, log Stations_per_1000sqkm, log Trains_Serving.
Mean of state-level PHC staffing % and log doctors per 100k. STATE resolution.
RuralReach Accessibility Index = 0.30 Education + 0.30 Transport + 0.20 Health + 0.20 Livelihood (weights renormalised over available pillars).
Low (bottom quartile) / Medium / High (top quartile) of RAI.
1 Critical gap (Farm share >= median and Low tier); 2 High priority; 3 Monitor; 4 Well served.
Local Moran's I class of RAI (k=8 neighbours, 499 permutations, p<0.05).
K-Means typology (k=5), ordered by mean RAI.
